entries.06e321c8b9fc9e7d: The three businesses are clearly divided by the regions of their customers. Looking at revenue from external customers by business and region for the fiscal year ended February 2026, Robotics is led by China at ¥68,108 million, Asia (excluding China) at ¥53,658 million, and Europe, the Middle East and Africa at ¥47,861 million, with Japan at ¥39,521 million in 4th place. For Motion Control, the Americas stands out at ¥90,221 million, followed by Japan at ¥58,335 million. System Engineering has only Japan at ¥32,673 million and Asia (excluding China) at ¥6,070 million, with no revenue recorded in the Americas, Europe, or China. On a consolidated basis, revenue is spread across the world: Japan ¥148,377 million, the Americas ¥128,503 million, China ¥116,075 million, Asia (excluding China) ¥81,020 million, and Europe, the Middle East and Africa ¥68,145 million. The company explains that while capital investment in the automotive market was weak in Japan, the Americas, and Europe, the semiconductor, electronic component, and machine tool markets recovered, led by AI-related investment.

entries.206bf3e05b30d4b3: Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥542,122 million. How revenue is recognized depends on the type of work. For product sales in Motion Control and Robotics, revenue is recognized at the point when the product is delivered to or accepted by the customer, and payment is mainly received within 4 months for Motion Control and mainly within 5 months for Robotics. By contrast, contract construction and similar work in Robotics and System Engineering involves building customer-specified equipment over a long period, so revenue is recognized over the period as costs are incurred. Maintenance contracts are separate again, with revenue recognized evenly over the contract period. The annual securities report states that 'many products are not made to order, and production and order volumes by segment are not presented in monetary or quantity terms', so order intake figures are not disclosed.

entries.2f8b76d9548ee7f1: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥47,307 million, and the operating margin was 8.7%. Operating profit by business was ¥24,384 million for Motion Control, ¥20,418 million for Robotics, ¥4,989 million for System Engineering and ¥1,988 million for Other. Robotics exceeded Motion Control in revenue, but in operating profit the order is reversed, with Motion Control ahead of Robotics, so the rankings differ. The company explains that Robotics recorded higher revenue from large projects in China and Asia but 'profit decreased due to the impact of value added from large projects', while Motion Control recorded lower revenue but 'profit increased year on year due to improvements in value added and other factors'. Even within the same company, a business that sells large volumes at low prices and a business that sells high value-added components earn profit in different ways. Company-wide operating profit decreased year on year, as higher revenue increased value added but did not offset the impact of foreign exchange and higher indirect costs.

entries.39359c889cbe9a4c: This business designs and delivers large electrical systems that run entire factories and infrastructure. The securities report states, “We are engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance services of industrial automation drives and social systems.” Its main work is taking charge of entire equipment rather than individual components, such as electrical systems for steel plants, electrical systems for water and sewerage systems and electrical systems for port cargo handling; it also handles high-voltage inverters, high-voltage matrix converters, industrial motors and generators, and generators for small-scale hydropower. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥38,744 million, operating profit was ¥4,989 million and the number of employees was 737, excluding 98 temporary employees; it is the smallest business of the 3 reportable segments. By region, revenue from external customers was only ¥32,673 million in Japan and ¥6,070 million in Asia excluding China, with no amounts recorded for the Americas, Europe or China. Its domestic focus differs greatly from the other 2 businesses, which generate most of their revenue overseas. The company explains that sales to steel plants and social systems remained firm, resulting in higher revenue, and that profit increased due to the increase in profit accompanying higher sales and improved value added.

entries.a4cd369abd21564b: This business is not included in the reportable segments. Note 1 of the securities report states, “The ‘Other’ category consists of business segments not included in the reportable segments and includes businesses such as logistics services.” At the center of this category is Yaskawa Logistec Corporation (Kokurakita Ward, Kitakyushu; capital of ¥200 million; voting rights 100%), which was established in March 1976 by separating the warehouse and shipping departments, and which handles transport, cargo handling and storage for the company’s products. This category also includes Aikyubu Digital Corporation, which handles software development, and FAMS Corporation, which handles engineering and sales. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥20,311 million, operating profit was ¥1,988 million, and the number of employees was 724, excluding 431 temporary employees. Revenue decreased 12.3% from the previous fiscal year, but operating profit increased 24.9% from the previous fiscal year due to an increase in other income. This category has a high share of work within the group; in the fiscal year ended February 2026, internal revenue and transfers between segments amounted to ¥17,401 million, close to its revenue from external customers.

entries.daece8ead7bcdce9: At the root are motors and the technology of how to drive them. The report states that in 1969 the company proposed the term "mechatronics (a coined word fusing mechanism and electronics)." The same technology is sold in three forms. AC servo motors, which stop accurately at a commanded angle, and inverters, which freely change a motor's rotation speed, are components built into machines. Industrial robots are equipment that combine those motors in many arms to perform welding, painting, and transport. And the electrical systems for steel plants and water and sewage systems are motors and control devices scaled up to the size of a facility.
entries.dde4120616f4d9f3: The group consists of YASKAWA Electric Corporation, headquartered in Yahatanishi-ku, Kitakyushu, and 66 subsidiaries and 13 affiliates (as of February 28, 2026). The number of employees is 12,483, and in addition, the average annual number of temporary employees is 1,879. The organization is divided by business rather than by region, and the annual securities report states, “The organization is structured mainly around 3 business units: Motion Control, Robot and System Engineering, and each business unit formulates comprehensive strategies for Japan and overseas and conducts its business activities.” Overseas companies such as Yaskawa America, Inc., Yaskawa Europe GmbH and Yaskawa Electric (China) Co., Ltd. are companies that handle manufacturing and sales by region rather than by business. The fiscal year-end in February is also an unusual arrangement among Japanese manufacturers, many of which have March year-ends.

entries.e7203f44586a4596: This business makes parts for moving machines at the speed and to the position desired. The securities report states, “We are engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance services of AC servo motors, control devices and inverters,” and according to the company’s description, the business consists of 2 businesses: the AC Servo Motor and Controller Business and the Inverter Business. AC servo motors are motors that stop precisely at the commanded angle, and inverters are devices that freely vary the rotational speed of a motor; both are components that equipment makers build into their own machines. The company also handles linear motors, AC spindle motors for machine tools, PM motors, digital galvano scanners, power regenerative converters, matrix converters and power conditioners for solar power generation. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥236,053 million, ranking second by revenue, but operating profit of ¥24,384 million was the largest of the 3 reportable segments. The number of employees was 4,975, excluding 867 temporary employees. By region, revenue from external customers was ¥90,221 million in the Americas, ¥58,335 million in Japan, ¥45,921 million in China, ¥21,291 million in Asia excluding China, and ¥20,284 million in Europe, the Middle East and Africa; with the Americas as the largest region, this is in contrast to the robot business. The company explains that, although revenue fell as a reaction to the normalization of order backlog pursued in the previous fiscal year, sales to the electronic components and machine tool markets were strong, driven by AI-related investment; demand conditions improved from the second half of the fiscal year, and profit increased due to improved value added.

entries.eee005c30865610e: This business manufactures and sells industrial robots that perform work in factories in place of people, and installs and maintains them. The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states, “We are engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of industrial robots and other products, as well as maintenance services.” Models are divided by application, such as welding, painting and handling parts, and the company offers arc welding robots, spot welding robots, painting robots, handling robots, sealing and cutting robots, deburring and polishing robots, clean and vacuum transfer robots for semiconductor and liquid crystal manufacturing equipment, human-collaborative robots that can work alongside people, and robots for biomedical applications, among others. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥247,012 million, the largest of the three reportable segments; operating profit was ¥20,418 million; and the number of employees was 4,728 (excluding 335 temporary employees). By region, revenue from external customers was ¥68,108 million in China, ¥53,658 million in Asia excluding China, ¥47,861 million in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, ¥39,521 million in Japan and ¥37,861 million in the Americas, with China and Asia together accounting for nearly half of sales. The company explains that revenue increased because, although sales to automotive markets in Japan, the Americas and Europe declined, large projects in China and Asia and the capture of capital investment demand in general industrial fields globally grew, while operating profit fell due to the impact of value added in large projects.
entries.f7d31e439fa511dc: The company sells a single technology, "motors and their applications," in three ways: as components, as equipment, and by contracting for complete facilities. The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] states: "For 110 years since its founding, we have stayed true to motors and their applications as our business domain, and have advanced motion control, power conversion, and robot technology." The AC servo motors and inverters sold by Motion Control are components that equipment manufacturers build into their own machines. The industrial robots sold by Robotics are equipment that do work themselves. System Engineering contracts for the entire electrical equipment of steel plants and water and sewage systems, and for contracted construction and similar work the report explains that "performance obligations are satisfied by manufacturing and providing products and the like based on customer specifications over a long period, so revenue is recognized according to how costs are incurred." Sales are not concentrated in one customer; the report states: "No external customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue in the consolidated statement of income, so the disclosure is omitted." Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥542,122 million, and revenue from external customers by [[term:segment|segment]] was ¥247,012 million for Robotics, ¥236,053 million for Motion Control, ¥38,744 million for System Engineering, and ¥20,311 million for Other, which is not included in the reportable segments.
